scripts.copy:js: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist/js')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/js', {recursive: true}); const jsFiles = fs.readdirSync('src/js').filter(f => f.endsWith('.js')); jsFiles.forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(`src/js/${f}`, `dist/js/${f}`)); console.log('✅ JS files copied')"
scripts.copy:css: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist/css')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/css', {recursive: true}); const cssFiles = fs.readdirSync('src/css').filter(f => f.endsWith('.css')); cssFiles.forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(`src/css/${f}`, `dist/css/${f}`)); console.log('✅ CSS files copied')"
scripts.build: npm-run-all clean build:scss:dev copy:js copy:css build:html:eleventy build:html:format
scripts.build:js:dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist/js')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/js', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/js/main.js', 'dist/js/main.js')"
scripts.build:prod: npm-run-all clean build:scss:prod build:js:prod build:html:eleventy build:html:minify
